overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on evaluating multimodal hallucination snowballing in Large Vision-Language Models. The main NLG tasks are Visual Question Answering and Dialogue Generation in conversational settings. The paper uses automatic metrics (Accuracy, Flip Rate, Weak Flip Rate) and conducts human evaluation for data quality verification. No LLM-as-judge evaluation is performed. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and minor additions.
